# ACE² Lab (Advanced Chemical & Energy Engineering Laboratory | 차세대 화학 및 에너지 공학 연구실)

> ACE² Lab is an interdisciplinary chemical and energy engineering research laboratory in the Department of Energy Chemical Engineering, College of Science and Technology, Kyungpook National University (경북대학교 과학기술대학 에너지화학공학과), co-directed by Associate Professors Changyong Yim (임창용 교수) and Taewook Kim (김태욱 교수). Located in Building 7 on the Sangju Campus, the laboratory pioneers ultrafast Intense Pulsed Light (IPL) photothermal nanomanufacturing, atomically thin 2D nanomaterials (MXene, MOFs, laser-induced graphene), next-generation electrochemical energy storage (hybrid supercapacitors, Li-ion battery anodes), environmental De-NOx SCR catalysis, and machine-learning-coupled flexible bio/gas sensors (E-nose).

## Principal Investigators (Co-PIs)

- [Prof. Changyong Yim (임창용 교수)](https://ace2.knu.ac.kr/members/#yim): Associate Professor, Ph.D. (POSTECH Chemical Engineering B.S. & Ph.D.; former Postdoc at POSTECH & University of Calgary; former Staff Engineer at Samsung Electronics IM Division; former Principal Researcher at RIST). Research focus: Intense Pulsed Light (IPL) photonic nanomanufacturing, 2D MXene/oxide interfacial engineering, hybrid supercapacitors, Li-ion battery anodes, flexible tactile/respiration and AI E-nose gas sensors.
- [Prof. Taewook Kim (김태욱 교수)](https://ace2.knu.ac.kr/members/#kim): Associate Professor, Ph.D. (POSTECH Chemical Engineering B.S. & Ph.D.; former Postdoc at POSTECH; former Staff Engineer at Samsung Electronics DS Division Semiconductor R&D Center; former Senior Researcher at KITECH). Research focus: Next-generation battery and supercapacitor electrode materials, environmental De-NOx SCR catalysis, desulfurization sorbents, and ceramic/metal 3D additive manufacturing materials.

## Core Research Pillars

- [Pillar 01 — Advanced Energy Storage & Nanomaterials (차세대 에너지 저장 및 기능성 나노소재)](https://ace2.knu.ac.kr/research/#energy-storage): Hybrid coin-cell supercapacitors (Co-MOF/Ni-Co sulfide nanopetal arrays, IPL/laser-processed Co3O4 and Co(OH)2 electrodes), porous 2D Ti3C2Tx and vanadium MXene/TiO2 nanocomposite anodes for Li-ion batteries, V2O5-WO3/TiO2 SCR catalysts, and additive manufacturing alloy durability.
- [Pillar 02 — Ultrafast Photonic Nanomanufacturing (초고속 펄스광 IPL 광열 나노공정)](https://ace2.knu.ac.kr/research/#photonic): Millisecond xenon flash lamp annealing (Intense Pulsed Light, IPL) for room-temperature sintering of oxidation-resistant Cu-Ag electrodes, VO2 phase-transition thermochromic films, colloidal quantum dot surface trap healing, and flashlight/laser-induced graphene (FIG/LIG).
- [Pillar 03 — Flexible Sensors & Bio-Environmental Devices (유연 센서 및 생체·환경 모니터링 소자)](https://ace2.knu.ac.kr/research/#sensors): Multi-layered MXene/mulberry-paper (Hanji) flexible tactile sensors for real-time CPR feedback, LIG respiration humidity sensors, machine-learning-assisted nanostructured electronic nose (E-nose) arrays for exhaled NO/NO2/NH3 breath diagnosis, and MOF-functionalized QCM/microcantilever resonators.

## Key Honors & Achievements

- [KIChE Chem Frontier National 1st Place (한국화학공학회 창의설계 경진대회 2년 연속 전국 1위)](https://ace2.knu.ac.kr/chem-frontier/): Two consecutive Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy Awards (산업통상부장관상, 2025 & 2026) and three consecutive top national honors including the 2024 Grand Prize (대상).
- [Publications & Intellectual Property (연구성과)](https://ace2.knu.ac.kr/publications/): Peer-reviewed SCI(E) international journal articles (featured on journal covers in Small, Inorganic Chemistry, etc.), {{ site.data.domestic.size }} domestic journal papers, {{ site.data.patents.size }} registered and filed patents, and {{ site.data.talks.size }} academic conference presentations.
